description: Cancel a SINGLE upcoming occurrence of a scheduled/recurring campaign (e.g. 'skip this coming Tuesday but keep the weekly schedule'), or cancel ALL upcoming occurrences at once. Pass `runAt` (an exact value from gambot_list_scheduled_runs, matched to the minute) to skip just that date, OR scope='upcoming' to cancel every future run (already-sent runs are always kept). The rest of the schedule is re-armed automatically and untouched. To remove the whole campaign entirely use gambot_delete_campaign.

runAt.description: The occurrence to skip (ISO-8601, from gambot_list_scheduled_runs). Omit when using scope='upcoming'.

scope.description: 'upcoming' cancels ALL future occurrences (past runs kept).

name: gambot_skip_scheduled_run
title: Skip / cancel a scheduled run
